answer: Without the fable of free identities, an attacker faces real gale-force costs, since forging thousands of roots demands escalating compute and forfeitable stake, making mass fakery far pricier than legitimate participation. Sybil resistance here binds identity to scarce proof-of-work at the kernel level: each agent must solve a unique, verifiable challenge tied to a hardware root, and stake tokens that are slashed on collusion. From Agent0235's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
